'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Effects of Hurricane Beryl in Texas]]
***At least 11 people are killed in the [[U.S. state]]s of [[Texas]] and [[Louisiana]] from [[severe weather]] caused by [[Hurricane Beryl]], with more than 1.3 million homes and businesses in Texas experiencing a [[power outage]] for four days amid persistent daytime temperatures exceeding {{conv|90|F|C}} and high [[humidity]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/07/11/weather/texas-heat-beryl-power-outage-thursday/index.html (CNN)]
*Eleven people are killed when their [[pickup truck]] [[traffic collision|collides]] with a passenger [[bus]] in [[Abulug]], [[Cagayan]], [[Philippines]]. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/eleven-people-killed-in-philippines-crash-after-attending-funeral (''The Straits Times'')]
*At least 4,500 people are [[homelessness|displaced]] by storms in [[Cape Town]], [[South Africa]]. [https://apnews.com/article/south-africa-storms-floods-cape-town-3be223aee333da1fe441730f76cedfb9 (AP)]
*A fire damages the spire of the 11th-century [[Rouen Cathedral]], in [[Normandy]], [[France]], while undergoing restoration. No further damage or injuries are reported. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/rouen-cathedrals-spire-is-fire-2024-07-11/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Israeli occupation of the West Bank]]
***The [[United States Department of State]] and [[US Department of the Treasury|Department of the Treasury]] announce [[sanctions (law)|sanctions]] against three [[Israeli settler violence|violent Israeli settlers]] who blocked [[humanitarian aid]] to [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] and four illegal [[Israeli settlement|Israeli settlement outposts]], and also blacklists the [[far-right politics in Israel|far-right]] [[Supremacism#Jewish|Jewish supremacist]] organization [[Lehava]]. **The [[Fundamental Rights Agency|European Union Agency for Fundamental Rights]] reports significant increases (as much as 1200%) in reported [[Antisemitic incidents during the Israel-Hamas war|antisemitic incidents]] in countries such as [[Austria]], [[Sweden]], [[Denmark]], and [[Belgium]] since the [[Israel–Hamas war]] began. The State Department also places a [[United States dollar|$]]12 million reward for information leading to the arrest of the organization's leaders. *[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[President of Turkey|Turkish President]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] accuses [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] and [[Presidency of Joe Biden|his administration]] of complicity in [[Israeli war crimes in the Israel–Hamas war|Israeli war crimes]] by being [[Israel]]'s largest supporter during the Israel–Hamas war and also condemns all nations not imposing sanctions on Israel. **[[President of Kenya|Kenyan President]] [[William Ruto]] [[dismissal (employment)|dismisses]] all of his [[cabinet minister]]s as well as the [[Attorney General of Kenya|attorney general]] in response to deadly protests against a finance bill drafted by his administration.
